job.title: Staff Software Engineer, Product Infrastructure
job.location: San Francisco, CA · Palo Alto, CA · Seattle, WA
job.pay_full: $208,454 – $364,795 a year base salary (US based applicants), plus equity

details.about: Pinterest is a platform where millions of people find creative ideas and plan for the things they love. This Staff Software Engineer helps shape the data infrastructure and platform capabilities behind Pinterest's Ads and Core engineering work, setting technical direction across database infrastructure, Manas workflows and the Matcha platform, and partnering with engineers across teams to make these systems reliable, easier to operate and easier to build on.
duties: Set technical direction for the data storage and serving systems behind Ads workloads
Design for reliability, performance, scalability, observability and safe schema and data migrations
Guide the design of Manas document-generation workflows: data contracts, validation, failure handling and production monitoring
Work with teams using these workflows on correctness, freshness and throughput, and make iteration safer
Shape Matcha's architecture and delivery plan: APIs, operational standards, onboarding patterns and measurable service objectives
Coordinate priorities, interfaces and rollouts with Ads engineering and infrastructure partners
Mentor engineers, lead design reviews and turn incident learnings into improvements
Use AI to speed up design exploration, documentation and repeatable checks, verifying the results
needs: Experience designing and operating production data infrastructure or distributed backend systems
Experience with data modeling, consistency and correctness, reliability, observability, capacity planning and safe migrations
Ability to design platform interfaces and production workflows with clear service objectives
Experience leading incremental technical delivery across teams with differing needs
Technical leadership through design reviews, incident learning, mentorship and metric-informed prioritization
Experience using AI to improve the speed and quality of engineering work, with a clear approach to testing and verifying its output
Sound judgment in protecting sensitive data and owning final engineering decisions
Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as Computer Science, or equivalent experience
details.benefits: Base salary $208,454 – $364,795 USD a year for US based applicants; the position is also eligible for equity. Final salary depends on factors including location, travel, relevant experience and particular skills. Details of benefits for the position are on Pinterest's careers site.
notes: In the office once a week: you need to be within commuting distance of Palo Alto, San Francisco or Seattle
